open.description: Whether the disclosure is expanded. Set to show the list initially.

source-count-label.description: Localized summary when there is one source. Use `{count}` for its number.

sources-count-label.description: Localized summary for multiple sources. Use `{count}` for their number.

--ki-density-space-scale.description: Multiplies every scaled container padding and gap (card, dialog, alert, list, list item, select listbox, tab panel, tooltip).

--ki-density-target-min.description: The smallest pointer target any density may produce: 24 x 24 CSS px by default and in compact (WCAG 2.5.8 AA), 44 x 44 in touch (WCAG 2.5.5). It floors a shrinking control but never lifts what a control paints: a control painted smaller extends its target to it, invisibly; rows and tabs grow to it (spec 045 A1).

--ki-focus-ring-color.description: Colour of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws: 3:1 or more against the page in every theme and scheme.

--ki-focus-ring-offset.description: Gap between a focusable component and its keyboard focus ring.

--ki-focus-ring-width.description: Thickness of the keyboard focus ring every focusable component draws (its outline). One token instead of one per component, so a mode or a theme changes every ring at once.

--ki-source-card-backdrop-filter.description: Complete backdrop filter for a source card.

--ki-source-card-bg.description: Resting background of a source card.

--ki-source-card-bg-image.description: Optional decorative image over a source card.

--ki-source-card-border.description: Border color of a source card.

--ki-source-card-border-width.description: Border width of a source card.

--ki-source-card-fg.description: Text on a resting source card.

--ki-source-card-hover-bg.description: Background of a hovered source card.

--ki-source-card-hover-fg.description: Text on a hovered source card.

--ki-source-card-radius.description: Corner radius of a source card.

--ki-source-number-bg.description: Background of the number in a source card.

--ki-source-number-fg.description: Text color of the number in a source card.

--ki-source-number-radius.description: Corner radius of the number in a source card.

--ki-source-number-size.description: Minimum size of the number in a source card.

--ki-sources-max-inline-size.description: Maximum line length of the source disclosure.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

--ki-typography-line-height-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography line height body 1.

--ki-typography-line-height-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography line height caption 2.

--ki-typography-size-body-1.description: semantic dimension for typography size body 1.

--ki-typography-size-caption-2.description: semantic dimension for typography size caption 2.

--ki-typography-weight-body-medium.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body medium.

--ki-typography-weight-body-semibold.description: semantic font weight for typography weight body semibold.

component.description: A disclosure with the ordered sources behind an answer.

domain.description: Hostname derived from the link destination.

number.description: Source order marker inside the card.
